author: Retro Game Corps
description:
GPD's new eGPU dock features cutting-edge connectivity options (MCIO and USB4v2); combined with exceptional build quality, this is the best desktop eGPU I've seen to date.

GPD G2: https://www.indiegogo.com/en/projects/gpdhk/gpdg2
GPD Box mini PC: https://www.indiegogo.com/en/projects/gpdhk/gpdbox

Phawx's G2 review: https://youtu.be/4JqcOSWmQTo
Aoostar AG03 review: https://youtu.be/DIpNujckmO4

This was a review unit sent to me by GPD.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
